title: Create a minimal black-and-white, full-screen hero landing page delivered as a s

messages.content:
Create a minimal black-and-white, full-screen hero landing page delivered as a single standalone HTML file using React 19, Framer Motion (motion/react), Lucide React (via ES module import map + Babel Standalone), and plain CSS (no Tailwind). Load Google Fonts Inter in weights 300, 400, 500, and 600.
Layout & Structure:
• Full viewport height (min-height: 100vh), pure white (#ffffff) background, flex column with justify-content: space-between and overflow: hidden.
• Fixed top navbar (z-index: 50, pointer-events: none on the nav container, pointer-events: auto on children).
• Full-viewport background video layer positioned behind all content (z-index: 0).
• Bottom footer block pinned to the bottom (z-index: 30) with a smooth white vertical gradient fade-up (linear-gradient(to top, #ffffff 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 50%, transparent 100%)).
Navbar Details:
• Left side:
	1. Brand logo: custom SVG of two rounded rectangles rotated at -35deg with solid black fill, paired with the text "NeuralKinetics" (15px, weight 500, hidden on mobile <768px, visible on desktop 768px+).
	2. Menu button: black pill (border-radius: 9999px) containing a white circle (28px mobile / 32px desktop) with a black Plus icon (lucide-react, size 12, strokeWidth={3}) and white "Menu" label (11px).
	3. Category pill: light gray (#F4F4F6) rounded-full container holding "Advanced Bionics" and "Cognitive AI" separated by a subtle vertical divider (hidden on mobile, visible on desktop).
• Right side:
	• Light gray (#F4F4F6) pill containing a black circle (28px mobile / 32px desktop) with a custom white 4-dot grid SVG icon and "Adaptive Systems" text (11px, hidden on mobile, visible on desktop).
Background Video:
• Source: https://cloudfront.net
• Attributes: autoPlay, loop, muted, playsInline, object-fit: cover.
• Centered wrapper at 80% width and 80% height on mobile, expanding to 100% width and 100% height on desktop (768px+).
Bottom Footer Content:
• Stacks vertically on mobile; switches to a horizontal row aligned to the bottom (align-items: flex-end, justify-content: space-between) on desktop (768px+).
• Left block:
	1. Eyebrow/subtitle row: solid black 8px circle + "Best digital banking card 2026" (13px, rgba(0,0,0,0.55)).
	2. Main heading: "One Card, Zero" / "Limits. Worldwide." split across two lines, font-weight: 300, letter-spacing: -0.03em, line-height: 1, sized clamp(2rem, 8vw, 4.5rem) on mobile and clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4.5rem) on desktop.
	3. Two pill CTA buttons (13px): "See Features" (solid black background, white text) and "How It Works" (transparent background, 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.35) border, black text).
• Right block:
	• Three white rounded-full tag pills (11px, 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12) border): "Neuromorphic", "AGI", and "Cybernetics".
Motion Animations (motion/react, easing [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]):
• Navbar: y: -16, opacity: 0 → y: 0, opacity: 1 (duration: 0.8).
• Background video wrapper: opacity: 0, scale: 1.05 → opacity: 1, scale: 1 (duration: 1.8).
• Footer wrapper: y: 20, opacity: 0 → y: 0, opacity: 1 (delay: 0.5, duration: 1.0).
• Subtitle row: y: 16, opacity: 0 → y: 0, opacity: 1 (delay: 0.6, duration: 0.8).
• Heading: y: 20, opacity: 0 → y: 0, opacity: 1 (delay: 0.8, duration: 0.8).
• CTA buttons: y: 16, opacity: 0 → y: 0, opacity: 1 (delay: 1.0, duration: 0.8).
Responsive Padding:
• Mobile (<768px): navbar padding 16px, footer padding 64px 16px 24px.
• Desktop (768px+): navbar padding 24px 32px, footer padding 80px 32px 32px.
